chapter_path_en: Risks and Methods of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing
chapter_path_zh: 洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法

stem: 为防范金融犯罪风险,所实施的政策、控制措施和程序必须:

options.A: 包括采用最新技术(例如人工智能(AI)和机器学习)的复杂且自动化的控制.
options.B: 与企业的规模和性质相称,经高级管理层批准,并定期审查
options.C: 由企业完成并由外部机构(例如审计或咨询公司)进行验证
options.D: 仅由第一道防线业务团队创建、批准和拥有,并每年进行审查

stem_en: In order to prevent financial crime risk, the implemented policies, controls, and procedures must:

options_en.A: Include sophisticated and automated controls that use the newest types of technology available, for example artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning
options_en.B: Be proportionate with regard to the size and nature of the firm, approved by senior management, and regularly reviewed
options_en.C: Be completed by the business and validated by an external firm, for example an auditing or consulting firm
options_en.D: Be created, approved, and owned only by first-line business teams, and reviewed annually
